ios.desc:
SimpList is designed to get out of your way—so you can add items fast, stay organized, and get on with your day.

Create lists for groceries, errands, packing, events, or anything else.
Add items by voice when your hands are full.
Share lists with family so everyone stays on the same page.

Why You’ll Love SimpList

• Fast to use — add items in seconds
• Voice input — speak to add while on the go
• Multiple lists — stay organized for any occasion
• Clean and simple — no clutter, no learning curve
• Quantities and details — add amounts when needed
• Share lists — auto-sync across your devices
• Works offline — even in stores with no signal
• iCloud sync — private, secure, and seamless

Perfect For

• Grocery shopping
• Target or Costco runs
• Meal prep & weekly planning
• Party & event planning
• Travel packing lists
• Chore lists & everyday reminders

SimpList is Designed For:

People who want things simple

Families that share responsibilities

Anyone who hates over-complicated apps

Get your list done — the simple way.
